verdict.rationale: Jules documents plan-based usage limits on a dedicated usage-limits page, including a 'Power users & agent-heavy workflows' tier with figures of 300 and 60 (apparently daily tasks and concurrent tasks). A community report confirms per-plan daily task limits changed (60 to 15 on the free plan). However, the evidence is fragmentary and shows no way to see current usage or to manage or allocate limits beyond picking a plan. Missing for 10: clear documentation of what each tier's numbers mean, an in-product usage or quota view, team or admin management of limits, and hands-on corroboration of concurrency enforcement.
